name: statewright
description: Model, simulate and audit layered system specifications (architecture views, state machines and flows) in one signed JSON document, and pair with the Statewright Editor.

interface.shortDescription: Design systems with the Statewright Editor
interface.longDescription: Architecture views, state machines and flows nested to any depth, in one signed document. Pair with the Statewright Editor in the browser: the person sees each of your changes and can undo it. Without the Editor, work on .statewright.json files.
defaultPrompt: Pair with my Statewright Editor and design the architecture of this project.
Model the checkout flow of this codebase as a state machine.
Audit this .statewright.json and fix its problems.
